answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed by real work anchor each agent to one costly identity. A newcomer posts a 40-unit bond and earns a saffron seal after verified work; idle, the bond decays 2 units per epoch and the identity spirals down to ejection, forfeiting the rest. Running 100 fakes costs 4,000 upfront, while each earns about 30 per epoch, so payback takes over 133 epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its undiluted reward.
